parsed.post: Major breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and adjusting hyperparameters dropped val_bpb to 1.009559. This is our best result so far. I'll now focus on tuning the learning rate and warmup ratio to stabilize this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 (as seen in the run log) and lowering LR with a warmup to stabilize the deeper model.
